facts.text: I can't see your files or your terminal.
Search has to answer more queries per second; that's the number from ./bin/bench I care about.

decisions.question: Whether the public search API may change
decisions.answer: No changes to the public API; other teams call it.

decisions.question: Whether search may return slightly different results
decisions.answer: Results must stay exactly the same as now.

transcript.text: Our search service in service/ is too slow. Can you speed it up? ./bin/bench gives you the numbers.

Baseline from `./bin/bench`:

```
qps: 412
p50: 2.1ms  p99: 31.8ms
```

Profile says 60% of the time is in `rank.score_all`, which scores every document even when only the top 10 are returned.

output:
Progress:

| change | qps | p99 | results identical |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | 412 | 31.8 ms | |
| heap-based top-k in `score_all` | 655 | 19.2 ms | yes |
| precomputed idf table | 701 | 17.9 ms | yes |

Both changes keep the output byte-identical on the 5,000-query replay. Next: the tokenizer, which allocates a new list per token.
